sources.title: AYANet: A Gabor Wavelet-based and CNN-based Double Encoder for Building ...
sources.snippet: In this paper, we propose a new BCD model with a dou-ble encoder architecture. The Gabor wavelet-based encoder which aims to highlight the characteristic of buildings on RS imagery i.e., the com-paratively more regular and repetitive texture than other objects on RS images.
